user.title: Connect an EZVIZ robot vacuum
user.description: This integration reuses the active session of the official EZVIZ integration. Choose the EZVIZ account the robot belongs to.

robot.title: Choose the robot
robot.description: The account has several robot vacuums. Choose the one to add; repeat the setup to add the others.

abort.ezviz_not_configured: Set up the official EZVIZ integration first.
abort.ezviz_not_loaded: The official EZVIZ integration is not loaded or could not list devices. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_robots: No robot vacuum that is not already configured was found on this EZVIZ account.

inspect.name: Inspect RS20 Pro
inspect.description: Returns sanitized device data for protocol diagnostics.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot. Leave empty to use the first configured robot.

map_diagnostics.name: Inspect RS20 Pro map
map_diagnostics.description: Tests read-only map and route access without controlling the robot.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot. Leave empty to use the first configured robot.

camera_diagnostics.name: Inspect RS20 Pro camera
camera_diagnostics.description: Opens a short transport diagnostic without saving an image.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot. Leave empty to use the first configured robot.

refresh_camera_snapshot.name: Capture RS20 Pro snapshot
refresh_camera_snapshot.description: Opens the camera briefly, stores one frame in memory and closes the stream.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot. Leave empty to use the first configured robot.

feature_request.name: Send raw feature request
feature_request.description: Admin only. Sends one GET or PUT to the robot's cloud feature/action endpoint and returns the raw response. For protocol discovery; a wrong PUT can change robot settings.

method.name: Method
method.description: GET reads a value, PUT writes it.

identifier.name: Identifier
identifier.description: Feature or action name, for example CarpetCleanCfg.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot. Leave empty to use the first configured robot.

api_request.name: Send raw API request
api_request.description: Admin only. Sends one request to the EZVIZ API host used by the account session and returns the response. For protocol discovery.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path on the EZVIZ API host, starting with '/'.
